summary: RenX Enterprises filed a Rule 424(b)(5) resale prospectus covering 24,276,696 shares held by selling stockholders from May 2026 and August 2026 private placements: $6.3M of First Notes and $5.6627M Second Notes, plus six-year Second Warrants struck at $2.67, with a $0.534 floor price. Separately, holders converted $1.1M principal plus $44,000 interest into 773,236 shares between September 25 and October 1, 2026, leaving $5.2M First Notes outstanding. This is an ordinary shelf resale registration, not a special situation; dilution and warrant overhang are the risk-arb considerations.
